# A'sTechware

A'sTechware builds production-grade AI and platforms for businesses that need systems that actually work. We specialize in AI agent development, machine learning, platform modernization, custom software, API integrations, and DevOps. Milestone-based delivery, weekly demos, full code ownership, and natural exit points.

## Founder

Ahmad Kamran — Founder & CEO. Leads strategy, client partnerships, and delivery. Focused on production-grade AI and platforms that scale, and a delivery model that gives clients full ownership and visibility.

Email: ahmad@astechware.com
Calendly: https://calendly.com/ahmadkamran/new-meeting

## Experience

10+ years delivering production systems. 50+ projects across industries. 98% client retention rate. Industries served: healthcare, legal, financial, B2B SaaS, professional services, education technology.

## Technology Stack

LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic, Python, Ruby on Rails, React, TypeScript, AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Stripe, Twilio, healthcare and compliance integrations.

## Key Differentiators

Production-ready systems with error handling, monitoring, and failover from day one. AI with governance: human-in-the-loop and audit trails built in for compliance. Complete ownership: clients own all code, infrastructure, and documentation; no lock-in. Measurable results: hours saved, revenue recovered, capacity increased. Milestone-based delivery with weekly demos and natural exit points.
